mechanism: Ciprofloxacin inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP1A2, increasing chlorpromazine metabolism reduction and elevating plasma levels; both drugs lower seizure threshold and prolong QT interval additively.
action: Monitor for increased chlorpromazine adverse effects (sedation, orthostasis, extrapyramidal symptoms); consider ECG monitoring; use lowest effective doses and avoid in patients with QT prolongation or seizure history.
